figurative_meaning_bn: ছোটখাটো কাজ; অল্পে সমাধা হয় এমন কাজ
figurative_meaning_en: Minor or petty tasks; work that can be accomplished with little effort
example_sentences_in_bangla: আমি এই খুচরা কাজগুলো দ্রুত শেষ করে দেব।
example_sentences_in_english: There are some odd jobs left to do.
I'll quickly finish these petty tasks.
note: The idiom reflects everyday Bengali life, emphasizing small, inconsequential activities.
